EUR.reason: Legacy EUR 2Y history is explicitly marked as not same-basis as the validated current ECB AAA Svensson spot curve. The engine refuses to splice the legacy history and uses only the validated weekly move.

current_sources.USD: U.S. Treasury Daily Par Yield Curve
current_sources.EUR: ECB AAA Svensson spot curve / ECB Data Portal
current_sources.GBP: Bank of England nominal government zero-coupon spot curve
current_sources.JPY: Japan Ministry of Finance JGB curve
current_sources.CAD: Bank of Canada government benchmark yields

dynamics_gate.rule: Do not infer speed, acceleration or Rates turning point from a one-point/weekly-only same-basis validation.

conclusion: Current G8 2Y snapshots are internally synchronized and source-tagged. Historical front-end dynamics are backtestable on the canonical basis for 7/8 currencies; EUR historical dynamics remain withheld until a same-basis ECB 2Y history is materialized.
